events.title: The earliest recorded Christmas on 25 December
events.description: A Roman calendar compiled in 354 records the birth of Christ celebrated in Rome on 25 December 336, the earliest evidence for the date. Why it was chosen remains debated.
events.html: A Roman calendar compiled in 354 records the birth of Christ celebrated in Rome on 25 December 336, the earliest evidence for the date. Why it was chosen remains debated.

events.title: Pope Leo III crowns Charlemagne emperor
events.description: During Christmas Mass in St Peter's, Leo III crowned the Frankish king Charlemagne Emperor of the Romans. It revived a western imperial title unused since 476.
events.html: During Christmas Mass in St Peter's, Leo III crowned the Frankish king Charlemagne Emperor of the Romans. It revived a western imperial title unused since 476.

events.title: William the Conqueror is crowned at Westminster
events.description: William of Normandy was crowned king of England in Westminster Abbey. Norman soldiers, mistaking the congregation's acclamation for a riot, set fire to nearby houses.
events.html: William of Normandy was crowned king of England in Westminster Abbey. Norman soldiers, mistaking the congregation's acclamation for a riot, set fire to nearby houses.

events.title: Washington crosses the Delaware
events.description: On Christmas night, George Washington led about 2,400 soldiers across the ice-choked Delaware River. At dawn they surprised the Hessian garrison at Trenton.
events.html: On Christmas night, George Washington led about 2,400 soldiers across the ice-choked Delaware River. At dawn they surprised the Hessian garrison at Trenton.

events.title: Mikhail Gorbachev resigns as Soviet president
events.description: In a televised address, Mikhail Gorbachev resigned. That evening the Soviet flag was lowered from the Kremlin and replaced by the Russian tricolour.
